edge_guide_host_github_desc: 1. Make a free public GitHub repo (like my-sims-mods). 2. Upload your exported manifest.json (or one catalog.json for all your {mods}). 3. Click the file on GitHub and click 'Raw' to copy the raw.githubusercontent.com link. 4. Paste that link into Auto-Update Info Link before packing your release .zip!
edge_guide_lineage_how_desc: Sanctuary OS recognizes {mods} by their unique SHA-256 file fingerprint instead of filenames. Every exported manifest.json keeps track of three things so updates never break:
edge_guide_lineage_layer1_desc: Saves the main .package fingerprint plus every sibling .package and .ts4script module in the current release so multi-file {mods} stay grouped under one parent card.
edge_guide_lineage_layer2_desc: Every time you click Pack Release (.zip) in your Sandbox folder, older release fingerprints automatically move into previous_hashes. When Sanctuary OS checks your online manifest.json, any {Citizen} who still has an older file in previous_hashes gets an Update Available badge!
edge_guide_lineage_layer3_desc: When a {Citizen} drops your new v1.1.0 .zip into Sanctuary OS, it checks their {Vault} against previous_hashes. Even if you renamed MyMod_v1.0.package to MyMod_v1.1.package, Sanctuary OS finds the old v1.0 file by its fingerprint and replaces it right in the same subfolder—no duplicate files!
edge_guide_lineage_rules_desc: In Rules & Upload, required {mods} and conflicts can match other {mods} by file fingerprint, catalog ID, or plain {mod} name (like 'XML Injector').
edge_guide_lineage_rules_title: Easy Required {Mods} & Conflicts (By Fingerprint or Name)
edge_guide_step1_desc: Drop your .package, .ts4script, and optional .cfg/.ini files into Dev/Sandbox (or click Import in the {Mason} Studio). Open the {mod} card and fill in Details & Versions (Name, Version, Content Rating 0–4, Patch Versions), Files & Folders (Twin scripts, Add-ons, Folder Layout), and Rules & Upload (Required Packs, Required {Mods}, and Conflicts).
edge_guide_step2_desc: Paste the link where your manifest.json (for one {mod}) or catalog.json (all your {mods} in one file) will live—like GitHub Raw, Cloudflare Pages, or your own site. Sanctuary OS packs this link right inside manifest.json and override.json in your release .zip!
edge_guide_step3_desc: Click Pack Release (.zip) in Rules & Upload (or the top-right inbox button). Sanctuary OS fingerprints every file in your release, saves manifest.json and override.json in your Sandbox folder, and creates {ModName}_v{Version}_SanctuaryRelease.zip. Upload the .zip to Patreon, Itch.io, CurseForge, or SFS, and upload manifest.json to your link!
edge_guide_step4_desc: When you make v1.1.0+, drop the new .package/.ts4script files into the same Sandbox folder, update the Version number, and click Pack Release (.zip) again. Sanctuary OS automatically remembers your old v1.0.0 file fingerprints inside previous_hashes and saves the new ones as current_hashes. Upload the updated manifest.json to your link—every {Citizen} with v1.0.0 will get an Update Available alert right away!
edge_guide_step5_desc: A {Citizen} drags your .zip into Sanctuary OS once. With zero annoying popups, Sanctuary OS saves your update link, marks the {mod} Up to Date, groups multi-file {mods} into one tidy card, checks Required Packs & Conflicts, alerts them when you update manifest.json, and swaps out old files automatically when they drop the new .zip!

landing_partners_connect_p1: Once your Partner Spoke application is approved by Keepers Core, open Wayfinder Operations -> Spoke Control -> Spoke Setup & Maintenance to generate your SANCTUARY-UPLINK:// token with your Project URL, Anon Key, and Service Role Key.
landing_partners_connect_p2: Keepers Core runs a quick connection check with your Spoke. Once verified, your game workspace appears right on the Sanctuary OS Hub switcher for Desktop, Web, and Mobile PWA {Citizens}!
landing_partners_connect_p3: Complete the 4-step Partner Spoke Readiness Check & Application on this page. Friendly human Keepers review your game details in Keepers Core.
landing_partners_connect_p4: Once connected, your Spoke receives global malware safety updates while keeping all community {Mod} listings, {Citizens}, and posts hosted on your own Supabase database.
landing_partners_maintain_p1: Manage your workspace daily from Wayfinder Operations: invite Architects and moderators, verify {Masons}, review community reports, check malware flags, and rotate your Supabase keys anytime.
landing_partners_maintain_p2: Every admin action is saved in your Spoke's audit_logs table. If your community ever wants to run solo, click 'Cut the Cord' in Spoke Control to disconnect immediately while keeping 100% of your database.
landing_partners_maintain_p3: Link your community's Stripe, Ko-fi, or Patreon page in Wayfinder Operations. 100% of donations go straight to your community while giving {Citizens} +30 days of Dev Builds per $5!
landing_partners_maintain_p4: Publish game patch updates, new {Mod} format rules, and broken-mod alerts directly to your {Citizens}' Desktop and Web apps in real time!
landing_partners_setup_h1: 1. Create Your Supabase Project & Run schema.sql
landing_partners_setup_p1: Create a dedicated Supabase project owned by your community team. Open the SQL Editor and run Sanctuary OS's 36-table schema.sql script to set up profiles, {mods}, {mod}_versions, {masons}, {blueprints}, audit_logs, and security policies.
landing_partners_setup_p2: Set up your game's supported {Mod} file types (.package, .ts4script, .pak, .esp, .rpf, .asi), install folders, load-order rules, and safety checks inside your Master Schema JSON.
landing_partners_setup_p3: Set up your game's categories, subcategories, load-order rules, and {Lab} sandbox settings using the built-in Master Schema Studio in Architect Console.
landing_partners_setup_p4: Choose your workspace's default theme, friendly terms ({Mods}, {Masons}, {Citizens}), and community style in Wayfinder Operations -> Spoke Aesthetics.
landing_partners_what_h1: 1. Community-Owned Game Workspace — Never Locked In
landing_partners_what_h2: 2. Zero Platform Fees (0% Cut) & Shared Supporter Perks
landing_partners_what_p1: A Sanctuary OS Partner Spoke is an independent, community-run game workspace (like Skyrim, GTA V, Stardew Valley, or Baldur's Gate 3). Your community owns its own Supabase database, Master Schema, {Mod} catalog, and themes—and can disconnect ('Cut the Cord') anytime without losing data!
landing_partners_what_p2: Sanctuary Foundry takes 0% of {Mason} or Partner Community tips. Partner Spokes connect their own Stripe, Ko-fi, or Patreon link in Wayfinder Operations, and every $5 a {Citizen} donates to a Partner Spoke also gives them +30 days of Global Dev Build access!
landing_partners_what_p3: Your Wayfinders and Architects manage your workspace's Master Schema, {Mod} safety checks, themes, and moderator roles independently inside your own database.
landing_partners_what_p4: Connecting a Partner Spoke makes your game workspace available across the Sanctuary OS Desktop App (Windows & Mac), Web Portal, and Mobile PWA with conflict checks, {Backups}, and {Blueprints}!

schema_doc_cache_files_desc: Game cache files (like localthumbcache.package) that get cleared automatically when you switch {Blueprints}.
schema_doc_default_lex_desc: The default word pack loaded automatically when you open this game.
schema_doc_depth_desc: How many subfolders deep the game can read script files (1 folder deep for .ts4script) vs. regular package files (5 folders deep).
schema_doc_display_name_desc: The game title shown in headers, workspace cards, and launch buttons.
schema_doc_dlc_desc: Folders and naming pattern (like EP01, GP01, SP01) used to detect installed packs on Windows & Mac, plus the launch command to test without certain packs.
schema_doc_exc_kw_title: Crash Keywords, Plain-English Explanation & How to Fix
schema_doc_exc_meta_desc: Rule ID, log file name hint, and warning level (Critical, Warning, Info) shown when a crash log is found.
schema_doc_exe_list_desc: All Windows (.exe) and Mac (.app) game apps Sanctuary OS looks for and launches.
schema_doc_exe_subdir_desc: Subfolder inside the game install folder where the app lives (like Game/Bin). Leave blank if the app is in the main folder.
schema_doc_ext_ignore_desc: Harmless readme or notes files (.txt, .md) ignored by the Unidentified File scanner.
schema_doc_ext_primary_desc: Package file types scanned by Conflict Radar to spot duplicate or conflicting resources.
schema_doc_ext_script_desc: Script mod file types (.ts4script, .asi, .dll) checked for folder depth and safety.
schema_doc_ext_supported_desc: All {Mod} file types that get linked into your game when you launch.
schema_doc_ext_vault_desc: All file types shown in your {Vault}, including {Mod} files plus .zip, .rar, and .7z downloads.
schema_doc_game_id_desc: Database and community ID that connects this setup to online catalogs and shared play sets.
schema_doc_id_desc: Unique ID for this game setup file used inside Sanctuary OS.
schema_doc_lab_ram_desc: How many seconds the game needs to run smoothly in {Lab} to pass testing, plus memory usage checks.
schema_doc_lab_saves_desc: Save file types (.save, .ver0) protected and watched during {Lab} testing.
schema_doc_lo_templates_desc: Numbering or line format used when Load Order is set to Numeric Prefix ({index:03}_) or Manifest List.
schema_doc_mac_mod_dir_desc: Default folder where {Mods} get installed on Mac.
schema_doc_mac_user_dir_desc: Mac folder where your saves, crash logs, and settings live. Supports ~/Documents and ~/Library/Application Support.
schema_doc_manifest_file_desc: Optional config or load-order file created inside your {Mods} folder (like Resource.cfg).
schema_doc_manifest_header_desc: The exact Resource.cfg text written when setting up Folder Priority override folders.
schema_doc_min_scout_desc: How many Simmer Scout reports are needed before a new {Mod} is confirmed in the catalog.
schema_doc_parsers_desc: Connects file types to built-in readers (dbpf, ts4script) and card badge labels (PACKAGE, SCRIPT, CONFIG).
schema_doc_route_exts_desc: Which file types use this route (like .world) and how many subfolders deep they can be (0 = flat).
schema_doc_route_flags_desc: Flatten puts files directly into the target folder without extra subfolders; Shared With Vanilla keeps a list in .sanctuary_deployed_links.json so official game files are never deleted.
schema_doc_route_id_desc: ID and name for a special install rule that sends certain file types outside the normal {Mods} folder.
schema_doc_route_target_desc: Picks the main folder (game_dir, user_data_dir, or mod_dir) and exact subfolder where those special files go.
schema_doc_scan_paths_desc: Standard Steam, EA App, Origin, Epic, GOG, and Mac /Applications folders checked automatically when finding your game.
schema_doc_tc_engine_desc: Core game install folders (Game, Data) backed up when you create an Engine State backup.
schema_doc_tc_world_desc: Save and household folders (saves, Tray, Options.ini) backed up when you create a World State backup.
schema_doc_tiers_desc: Sets up the priority tiers players can pick from. Higher priority folders win when two {Mods} edit the same thing.
schema_doc_ver_file_desc: File that holds your current game patch version (like GameVersion.txt) and the pattern used to read it.
schema_doc_version_desc: Version number for this schema. Raising this number lets connected players know a new schema update is ready.
schema_doc_win_mod_dir_desc: Default folder where {Mods} get installed on Windows (like Documents/Electronic Arts/The Sims 4/Mods).
schema_doc_win_user_dir_desc: Windows folder where your saves, crash logs, and Options.ini live. Supports %USERPROFILE%, %LOCALAPPDATA%, and %APPDATA%.
schema_guide_backups_airgap_desc: Folders listed here (saves, Tray) are safely backed up before a {Lab} test run and restored right after, so testing new {Mods} can never mess up your family saves!
schema_guide_ext_config_desc: Settings files listed here (.cfg, .ini, .json) — like mc_settings.cfg — are watched automatically! When a {Mod} updates its settings in-game, Sanctuary OS saves those changes back to your {Vault} and cleans up extra root copies.
schema_guide_hero_desc: A Master Schema JSON tells Sanctuary OS how to find your game, install {Mods}, manage load order, protect your saves, and read crash logs like lastException.txt — whether you're playing The Sims 4, Cyberpunk 2077, GTA V, Skyrim, or Stardew Valley.
schema_guide_hero_title: Works With Any Game on Windows & Mac
schema_guide_lo_desc: Pick Folder Priority (tier folders like ZZ_Overrides), Numeric Prefix ({index:03}_), Manifest List (auto-builds Resource.cfg or plugins.txt), or Modified Timestamp Order.
schema_guide_logs_matcher_desc: Use Prefix + Extension (Starts With: lastexception, Ends With: .txt) to catch numbered Sims 4 crash logs, or switch Rule Type to Exact Filename (like mc_lastexception.html) for specific files.
schema_guide_logs_rules_desc: Scans your logs for keywords (like AttributeError | ImportError), marks the severity, and gives you plain-English tips on how to fix the broken {Mod}.
schema_guide_safe_preserve_desc: Keeps subfolder structures inside .zip/.rar downloads intact when importing (great for games that need exact folder paths).
schema_guide_safe_shared_desc: Turn this on when {Mods} get placed directly into a folder that also holds official game files. Sanctuary OS keeps a list in .sanctuary_deployed_links.json so it only removes your {Mods} and never touches official game files.
schema_guide_safe_wrap_desc: Neatly organizes loose .package and .ts4script files into their own named subfolder inside your {Vault} and {Mods} folder.
schema_guide_subtitle: Game Setup, Custom Routing & Safety Guide

wf_sever_identity_arch_desc: In Hub-and-Spoke mode, login details (emails, passwords, and Passkeys) are stored only in the main Hub database while your community database stores public.profiles (ID, username, and role). When you launch a Standalone Fork, your database's auth.users table starts fresh: the first person to sign up becomes Founding Wayfinder, and signing up with an existing community username automatically reconnects your profile, {Mason} page, {Mods}, {Blueprints}, and tickets to your new login!
wf_sever_identity_arch_title: How Accounts Work When Forking (Hub Login vs. Community Profiles)

wf_sever_warning_desc: Cutting the cord immediately removes your community from the global Hub list and scrubs your Service Role Key while keeping 100% of your 36 community tables safe.
